IN pursuance of the provisions of clause (3) of Article 348 of the Constitution of India, the
Governor is pleased to order the publication of the following English translation of notification
no. 2799/IX-1–2022-45 T.A.-22, dated September 22, 2022:
No. 2799/IX-1–2022-45 T.A.-22
Dated Lucknow, September 22, 2022
WHEREAS Government notification no. 765/IX-1–2022-34T.A.-2022 dated July 15, 2022 was
issued and published in the Gazette with a view to invite objections and suggestions from general public
with respect to the inclusion of the areas specified in the Schedule below in the transitional area of
Nagar Panchayat Ekdil, district Etawah as required by sub-section (1) section 4 of the Uttar Pradesh
Municipalities Act, 1916 (U.P. Act no. II of 1916);
AND, WHEREAS, objections and suggestions received in pursuance of said notification were
disposed of vide Government order no. 2737/IX-1–2022-45T.A.-2022 dated September 14, 2022;
NOW, THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers under clause (2) of Article 243-Q of the Constitution
of India read with sub-section (2) of section 3 of the Uttar Pradesh Municipalities Act, 1916 (U.P. Act
no. 2 of 1916) and in partial modification of notification no. 60/11-235(E)-Muarikha, dated
January 1, 1916 and other previous notifications issued in this behalf, the Governor having regard to the
population of the area, the density of the population therein, the revenue generated for local administration,
the percentage of employment in non-agricultural activities, the economic importance and such other
factors is pleased to include the areas specified in Schedule below in the transitional area of Nagar
Panchayat Ekdil, district Etawah for the purposes of Part IX-A of the Constitution of India.
